specs.Compatible Devices: Bluetooth headphones, earbuds, and Auracast-compatible hearing aids
specs.Supported Standards: aptX Adaptive, aptX HD, aptX, SBC, LC3
specs.Compatibility Options: Television, Bluetooth headphones, Auracast-compatible hearing aids
specs.Audio Output Type: TVs with Optical or AUX output

features: 【Watch TV with Bluetooth Headphones】 Connect to your TV (Optical/AUX) and stream to Bluetooth headphones from brands like AirPods, Bose for private listening.

【BUILT FOR AURACAST HEARING AIDS】Designed for modern hearing aids with Auracast support, such as GN Danalogic Extend, Jabra Enhance Pro 20, and ReSound Nexia. Pairing requires compatible devices like Samsung Galaxy S20+ or official hearing aid apps.
【Latest Bluetooth 5.4 Tech】 Powered by Qualcomm chip with aptX Adaptive for low-latency, high-resolution audio and long-term compatibility.
【Audio Sharing Made Easy】 Share TV audio with multiple listeners at once, ideal for family viewing or small venues, via Auracast broadcast.
【Future-Proof with Upgrades】 USB-C firmware updates (DFU) keep your device compatible with the latest Bluetooth audio standards.
【Built-in Display & Volume Control】 Check pairing status instantly and adjust volume directly with the physical knob.
description: Avantree Audikast 4 - Latest Bluetooth 5.4 TV Transmitter with Auracast for Headphones & Hearing Aids, Premium Qualcomm Chipset with aptX Adaptive & HD, Compatible with Optical & AUX Output
